source: Permissions that the permissions reference of Microsoft Learn documents (concepts/permissions-reference.md), and that raw/permissions-descriptions.json does not have yet. Written by hand from that page. A permission that the file gets later wins, and its entry here is ignored.

delegatedScopesList.adminConsentDescription: Allows the app to read and update users, on behalf of the signed-in user.

applicationScopesList.adminConsentDescription: Allows the app to read and update users, without a signed-in user.
